name: Rajendra Ranjit Pachauri
original_name: ラージェンドラ・ランジット・パチャウリー
source:
Researcher at Bell Labs and RA of the dorm. In charge of the dorm cafeteria, but can't cook much other than curry. He asks everyone to call him Dora-chan because they can't pronounce his full name.

Stats: luck 2 / intelligence 5 / popularity 3 / special ability 2 / physical strength 2 / influence 3
Special Skill: making curry
